entity: US 2017 home-purchase mortgage denial rate, Black vs white applicants
why: CFPB/FFIEC: Black applicants were denied more often for 2017 conventional home purchase loans; Urban Institute: the Black denial rate was 2.0x white in 2017. 'At every big lender' has no count and no names, so it isn't more; Urban's 1.2x is a credit-adjusted rate (different definition) and Reveal's Santander ~3x was published before the 2017 data existed, so neither contradicts.
